description: This file contains the implementation of a Settings dialog in an Android app using Jetpack Compose. It includes UI components for theme selection, dark mode, dynamic color preferences, and links to policies and licenses.

classes.name: SettingsDialog
classes.description: Composable function displaying the main settings dialog with title, content, and dismiss button.

classes.name: SettingsPanel
classes.description: Composable for rendering theme, dark mode, and dynamic color options within the settings dialog.

classes.name: SettingsDialogSectionTitle
classes.description: Reusable composable for section titles within the settings dialog.

classes.name: SettingsDialogThemeChooserRow
classes.description: Row component with radio button for selecting a theme option.

classes.name: LinksPanel
classes.description: Displays external links such as privacy policy, licenses, brand guidelines, and feedback.

methods.name: SettingsDialog
methods.description: Main composable function to show the settings dialog, manages state and view model interactions.

methods.name: SettingsPanel
methods.description: Displays theme, dark mode, and dynamic color options based on current settings.

methods.name: SettingsDialogSectionTitle
methods.description: Displays section titles within the dialog.

methods.name: SettingsDialogThemeChooserRow
methods.description: Displays a selectable row with a radio button for theme options.

methods.name: LinksPanel
methods.description: Displays external links related to app policies and licenses.
